description.p: A Remote Desktop client for Windows PCs built so that scrolling, video and window resizing feel as smooth as the Windows client does. H.264 video is decoded on the GPU through VAAPI and composited with OpenGL, and frames are shown as soon as they are decoded.

ul.li: Hardware H.264 and AVC444 (full colour) decoding
Local hardware cursor and smooth resizing
Clipboard for text, formatted text and images
Smart card redirection and smart card sign-in
Connection manager with passwords kept in the system keyring
